fact: The Kenya Joint Disability Strategy 2025-2027 (26 August 2025) cites the Persons with Disability Act 2025, Part III s26(2), giving every person with disability a right to ICT and systems including talking software, Braille and assistive devices, and records a government commitment of USD 5 million with AT-Scale to reach 275,000 persons with assistive technology by 2027.
title: Kenya Joint Disability Strategy 2025-2027 Final Report
